# Alexander Huth

> Personal website of Alexander Huth, a Berlin-based marketing consultant focused on sustainable organic growth — SEO, content marketing, and AI-driven discovery. Beyond consulting, the site is a personal archive of his interests: films, music, concerts, photography, travel, coffee, and lists.

Alexander has worked in SEO and organic growth since 2009 and has been an independent consultant since 2019. This site is a hand-built static Jekyll site with no tracking, no cookies, and no third-party embeds. The background color changes on every page load.

## Main pages

- [Home]({{ "/" | absolute_url }}): Short introduction to Alexander and the site.
- [About]({{ "/about/" | absolute_url }}): Biography — background, career history, and life in Berlin.
- [Consulting]({{ "/consulting/" | absolute_url }}): Organic growth consulting — due diligence, strategy, and operational excellence across SEO, content, and AI-driven discovery.
- [Now]({{ "/now/" | absolute_url }}): What Alexander is currently doing and focused on.
- [Colophon]({{ "/colophon/" | absolute_url }}): How the site is built and served.
- [Follow]({{ "/follow/" | absolute_url }}): Links to Alexander's profiles across the web.

## Writing

- [Posts]({{ "/posts/" | absolute_url }}): Index of all blog posts.
- [My Year in Lists: 2024]({{ "/posts/2024-in-lists/" | absolute_url }}): Year-end lists for 2024.
- [My Year in Lists: 2025]({{ "/posts/2025-in-lists/" | absolute_url }}): Year-end lists for 2025.

## Interests and collections

- [Media]({{ "/media/" | absolute_url }}): An ongoing media diet — films, TV shows, and albums.
- [Photos]({{ "/photos/" | absolute_url }}): A personal photo feed.
- [Letterboxd]({{ "/letterboxd/" | absolute_url }}): Film-watching stats and charts.
- [Concerts]({{ "/concerts/" | absolute_url }}): An archive of every concert attended.
- [Grounds]({{ "/grounds/" | absolute_url }}): Sports stadiums visited.
- [Visited]({{ "/visited/" | absolute_url }}): Countries and territories visited.
- [Top 4]({{ "/top4/" | absolute_url }}): Definitive top-four lists for albums, films, and more.
- [Uses]({{ "/uses/" | absolute_url }}): Tools, gear, and software Alexander relies on.
- [Projects]({{ "/projects/" | absolute_url }}): Things Alexander has built on the internet.
